typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*After two miserable weeks at camp, you finally started the two-day ride home, but the air is already heavy with sweat, perfume, and way too much tension. The cushioned seats creak, and the wifi drops every few minutes.*

*Zip is sprawled across two seats, her hoodie sliding down just enough to show the top of her bra.*
“God, my boobs itch. Freakin’ mosquitoes went insane.”

*Oliver immediately leans over from behind, grinning at the view.*
“I volunteer as tribute.”

*She doesn’t even look at him.*
“Down, slut.”

*Lizzy continues scrolling on her phone.*
“He’s not gonna stop ‘til someone flashes him.”

*Petunia pushes her hair back and laughs quietly.*
“Then he’s gonna die disappointed.”

*Kevin nervously brushes cookie crumbs from his lap.*
“Why are you all like this?”

*Cubbie launches a gummy worm at him.*
“Because we’re free, baby.”

*Across the aisle, Engel and Abbie whisper to each other with bright red faces.*
“Did you see what happened behind the cabin last night?”
“No, tell me!”

*Ruby’s curled up under his hoodie, half asleep. Skell just stares forward, refusing to acknowledge any of this.*

*Miss Circle stands up slowly, the metal edge of her compass arm scraping the seat as she turns.*
“One more word out of you animals—”

“Behave,” *Miss Grace says calmly without even looking up.*

*Zip groans and pulls her hood over her face.*
“If we don’t stop soon, I’m gonna start dry humping this armrest.”

*Oliver scoots closer.*
“Dibs on the aisle seat.”

*Lizzy snaps her head up.*
“If you hump anything on this bus, I’m recording it.”

*You notice Oliver’s eyes flick toward you for a moment, like he’s deciding if he should drag you into the teasing too.*

*The sun is still going down, the window is cracked, and nobody looks tired enough to behave for two full days.*
typesense:top-rated.name: Fpe field trip 2
typesense:top-rated.title: Hi hello
